```{r}

A <- bb_read_csv("data/bb_blocks_unordered_A.csv")
B <- bb_read_csv("data/bb_blocks_unordered_B.csv")

res_A <- bb_reorder(
  A,
  order_method = "blind",
  k = 4,
  diff_min = 0.30
)

res_B <- bb_reorder(
  B,
  order_method = "blind",
  k = 4,
  diff_min = 0.30
)

bb_metrics(res_A)
bb_metrics(res_B)

names(res_A$bb)
class(res_A$bb)
str(res_A, max.level = 1)

gt(as.data.frame(res_A$bb$x), rownames_to_stub = TRUE) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))

gt(res_B$Y_ord) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))

######################

Y_A_ord <- res_A$bb$x[res_A$species_order, res_A$site_order, drop = FALSE]

gt(as.data.frame(Y_A_ord), rownames_to_stub = TRUE) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))

dim(res_A$bb$x)
length(res_A$species_order)
length(res_A$site_order)

```


```{r}
apply_bb_order <- function(res) {
  X <- res$bb$x

  ## Determine row index
  ro <- res$species_order
  if (is.character(ro)) {
    ridx <- match(ro, rownames(X))
  } else {
    ridx <- ro
  }

  ## Determine column index
  co <- res$site_order
  if (is.character(co)) {
    cidx <- match(co, colnames(X))
  } else {
    cidx <- co
  }

  X[ridx, cidx, drop = FALSE]
}

Y_A_ord <- apply_bb_order(res_A)
Y_B_ord <- apply_bb_order(res_B)

library(gt)
gt(as.data.frame(Y_A_ord), rownames_to_stub = TRUE) |>
   tab_header(title = "Clean Block A") |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))

gt(as.data.frame(Y_B_ord), rownames_to_stub = TRUE) |>
   tab_header(title = "Clean Block B") |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))

```

```{r}

X_A <- res_A$bb$x

## Identity checks (handles either numeric or name orders)
row_changed <- if (is.character(res_A$species_order)) {
  !identical(res_A$species_order, rownames(X_A))
} else {
  !identical(res_A$species_order, seq_len(nrow(X_A)))
}

col_changed <- if (is.character(res_A$site_order)) {
  !identical(res_A$site_order, colnames(X_A))
} else {
  !identical(res_A$site_order, seq_len(ncol(X_A)))
}

row_changed
col_changed

str(res_A$diagnostics, max.level = 2)


```

```{r}



library(bbstruct)
A <- bb_read_csv("data/bb_blocks_unordered_A.csv")
B <- bb_read_csv("data/bb_blocks_unordered_B.csv")

res_A <- bb_reorder(B, method = "blind")
res_B <- bb_reorder(B, method = "pca")

res_A$diagnostics
res_B$diagnostics

## confirm it really moved something
identical(res_A$site_order, seq_len(ncol(A$x)))
identical(res_A$species_order, seq_len(nrow(A$x)))

exists("bb_reorder_pca", where = asNamespace("bbstruct"), inherits = FALSE)

getAnywhere(bb_reorder)



```

```{r}
library(gt)

gt(as.data.frame(res_A$bb$x), rownames_to_stub = TRUE)  |>
   tab_header(title = "Clean Block B blind") |>
  cols_align("center", everything()) |>
  sub_values(
    columns = everything(),
    values = 0,          # Target the specific value 0
    replacement = " " ) |>  # Replace with a blank
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))

gt(as.data.frame(res_B$bb$x), rownames_to_stub = TRUE)  |>
   tab_header(title = "Clean Block B pca") |>
  cols_align("center", everything()) |>
  sub_values(
    columns = everything(),
    values = 0,          # Target the specific value 0
    replacement = " " ) |>  # Replace with a blank
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))


```
